text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've brought Mejiro Ardan to the
infirmary, as
she's suffered an injury
during training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I sincerely apologize for worrying you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That said, given my medical history, I
know from
experience that this injury is
of no concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, my treatment's concluded. Let's
resume
training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Well, my treatment's concluded. Let's
resume
training.
choice_data_list: 今日は大事を取って休もう
わかった、無理のない範囲でな
わかった、無理のない範囲でね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Cooler heads prevail... is your
implication, I
imagine?
choice_data_list: 今日は大事を取って休もう
わかった、無理のない範囲でな
わかった、無理のない範囲でね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I know very well just how frightening
injuries can
be. Very well. I shall focus on
recovering for now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A slightly disappointed Mejiro Ardan
returns to
the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I shall keep a close eye on
my injury.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I wasn't expecting it... to hurt this
much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...It appears I might have been rushing
my
recovery. The prospect of my
progress coming to
a halt was just too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Aggravating this injury further would be
the worst
thing I could possibly do. ...I
really should be
resting, shouldn't I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A frustrated Mejiro Ardan trudges back
to the
dorm.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Light calisthenics appear perfectly safe.
...This
much exercise will do for now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What's more important than anything
else is the
feeling that I'm making
progress in spite of my
injury. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While monitoring her injury, Mejiro
Ardan
completes a light training session.
